title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
firstLine: The Time Traveller (for so it will be convenient to speak of him) was expounding a recondite matter to us.
begins: At a dinner party in the Time Traveller's house, he explains to his guests, including Filby, the Psychologist and the Medical Man, that time is a fourth dimension. His listeners are sceptical.
happens: The Time Traveller shows friends a small model time machine, then a week later tells them that he built a full-size one and travelled to the year 802,701. There he finds the childlike, gentle Eloi, and meets Weena, whom he saves from drowning. His machine is stolen by the Morlocks, pale underground creatures who feed on the Eloi. He sees that humanity has split into two. He and Weena flee through a forest fire, which kills her, and he regains the machine. He travels far ahead to a dying Earth. After telling his story he leaves on another trip and never comes back; the narrator is left with two white flowers.
